description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - play watch: at a playground, the parent rests on a bench while a side line watches the play area - register the area by looking at it and holding steady, then a timer reminds the parent to look back every 5 minutes (DEMO interval); a look-back confirmed by tap or steady nod resets the timer, an unconfirmed reminder escalates (banner, then one TTS + brighter banner, then a strong 'go and look in person' reminder), and the session ends with a small summary. No tracking, no face or person recognition, no camera, no mic, no location: it never knows where the child is, it only reminds the parent to look. Session memory only, wiped on close.
name: play-watch
